title: Abaphuli bomnqophiso ababesekuthinjweni
intro: Kwimihla yokuqala yoluntu olutsha, isizwe sasihlala kwiindawo zokuhlala ezinqatyisiweyo, sibotshelelwe sisivumelwano. Xa eso sivumelwano saphunyezwa, iziphumo zavakala kumaphepha eQuran. Babengoobani aba bantu, kwaye kwenzeka ntoni ngamakhaya abo kunye neziqhamo zabo?
clues: Sasihlala kwiindawo eziqinileyo ezazisinika uluvo lobuxoki lokhuseleko.
Sasingabantu beZibhalo, kodwa saphula umnqophiso wethu.
Saceba nxamnye nomthunywa emva kokuba eze kuthi, kodwa icebo lethu lawa phantsi.
Imithi yethu yesundu yanqunyulwa ngomyalelo ka-Allah, uphawu lwamandla akhe.
Sagxothwa emakhayeni ethu, asizange siphinde sibuye, njengesohlwayo sokungathobeli kwethu.
IQuran ikhankanya thina kwisahluko sale ntlanganiso, kwaye ibali lethu lisebenza njengesilumkiso kwabo baphula izivumelwano.
arabic: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ أَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَىٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِىَ ٱلْفَـٰسِقِينَ
verse: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient. (59:5)
